edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the origin of the balance debit
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance spender and allowance key
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender as owner
increaseApproval reads and writes allowance keyed by msg.sender
decreaseApproval reads and writes allowance keyed by msg.sender
Ownable constructor assigns owner from msg.sender
PoolinToken constructor mints the initial supply to msg.sender
onlyOwner require compares the untrusted caller msg.sender against owner
the owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner authorization check
_transferOwnership reads the current owner for the OwnershipTransferred event
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable
Ownable constructor writes the initial owner
pause writes true into the paused state variable
unpause writes false into the paused state variable
pause is gated by the whenNotPaused modifier reading paused
unpause is gated by the whenPaused modifier reading paused
transfer mutates the balances mapping
transfer performs SafeMath.sub on the sender balance

transferFrom performs SafeMath.add on balances[_to]
